title: Bonjour l'hiver
oneGoal: Students recognize and point to winter words in pictures
decisionPoints: Are students comfortable with new sounds?
Do they need more visual support?
Should we add more movement?
progression: First lesson - builds foundation for winter vocabulary
realWorldConnection: Recognizing winter weather when going outside

title: Les vêtements d'hiver
oneGoal: Students identify winter clothing items through gestures and pointing
decisionPoints: Can students connect clothing to weather?
Do they need real clothing props?
Are gestures helping comprehension?
progression: Builds on Lesson 1 by adding practical winter vocabulary
realWorldConnection: Getting dressed for winter weather

title: Activités d'hiver
oneGoal: Students act out simple winter activities using body language
decisionPoints: Are students connecting actions to words?
Do they need more physical movement?
Should we repeat activities?
progression: Builds on Lesson 2 by adding winter action words
realWorldConnection: Playing outside in winter

title: Ma famille en hiver
oneGoal: Students point to family members in winter scene pictures
decisionPoints: Can students connect family to winter activities?
Do they need photos of diverse families?
Are they ready for simple phrases?
progression: Builds on Lesson 3 by connecting family to winter experiences
realWorldConnection: Spending time with family during winter

title: Les célébrations commencent
oneGoal: Students recognize different celebration symbols through pictures
decisionPoints: Are students connecting symbols to celebrations?
Do they need more diverse celebration examples?
Should we add music to support understanding?
progression: Builds on Lesson 4 by introducing celebration concepts
realWorldConnection: Seeing decorations and celebrations in community

title: Traditions du monde
oneGoal: Students explore celebration traditions from different cultures through images
decisionPoints: Are students noticing similarities between cultures?
Do they need more sensory experiences?
Should we invite family sharing?
progression: Builds on Lesson 5 by expanding to multicultural celebrations
realWorldConnection: Learning about neighbors' different celebrations

title: Histoire d'hiver magique
oneGoal: Students follow a simple winter story using pictures and gestures
decisionPoints: Are students following the story sequence?
Do they need more repetition?
Should we act out parts together?
progression: Builds on Lesson 6 by introducing story structure
realWorldConnection: Listening to stories at home or library

title: Chansons de célébration
oneGoal: Students join in simple celebration songs with actions
decisionPoints: Are students comfortable participating?
Do they need simpler melodies?
Should we focus on rhythm first?
progression: Builds on Lesson 7 by adding musical elements to celebrations
realWorldConnection: Singing songs during family celebrations

title: Créons ensemble
oneGoal: Students participate in making simple celebration crafts
decisionPoints: Are students understanding craft directions?
Do they need simpler steps?
Should we work in pairs?
progression: Builds on Lesson 8 by creating celebration items
realWorldConnection: Making decorations or gifts at home

title: Jeux d'hiver amusants
oneGoal: Students play simple winter-themed games following French directions
decisionPoints: Are students understanding game rules?
Do they need visual rule cards?
Should we modify for inclusion?
progression: Builds on Lesson 9 by adding interactive play elements
realWorldConnection: Playing games during winter gatherings

title: Nourriture de fête
oneGoal: Students identify and sort celebration foods from different cultures
decisionPoints: Are students connecting food to celebrations?
Do they need real food examples?
Should we discuss family foods?
progression: Builds on Lesson 10 by exploring celebration foods
realWorldConnection: Special foods during family celebrations

title: Cartes de célébration
oneGoal: Students create simple celebration cards with pictures and French words
decisionPoints: Can students copy simple French words?
Do they need letter templates?
Should we focus on pictures first?
progression: Builds on Lesson 11 by creating celebration communication
realWorldConnection: Making cards for family and friends

title: Pratique de présentation
oneGoal: Students practice sharing their celebration learning through show and tell
decisionPoints: Are students ready to share?
Do they need more practice time?
Should we use partner sharing first?
progression: Builds on Lesson 12 by preparing for final presentation
realWorldConnection: Sharing experiences with family

title: Célébration finale
oneGoal: Students demonstrate their learning through a celebration presentation
decisionPoints: Are students confident to present?
Do they need supportive audience?
Should we celebrate everyone's effort?
progression: Builds on Lesson 13 by culminating all learning
realWorldConnection: Participating in real celebrations

title: Atelier de cartes créatives
oneGoal: Students create additional celebration cards using learned vocabulary
decisionPoints: Do students want to make more cards?
Should we introduce new materials?
Can they help each other?
progression: Extension of Lesson 12 - more creative card making
realWorldConnection: Making cards throughout winter season

title: Histoires d'hiver libres
oneGoal: Students tell their own winter stories using picture supports
decisionPoints: Are students ready for creative storytelling?
Do they need story starters?
Should we record their stories?
progression: Extension of Lesson 7 - student-created stories
realWorldConnection: Telling stories about personal winter experiences

title: Festival de chansons
oneGoal: Students perform favorite celebration songs with confidence
decisionPoints: Which songs do students prefer?
Do they want to add instruments?
Should we invite an audience?
progression: Extension of Lesson 8 - performance confidence building
realWorldConnection: Performing in family or community celebrations

title: Atelier de bricolage avancé
oneGoal: Students create complex winter celebration decorations
decisionPoints: What materials spark most interest?
Do they want to work individually or in groups?
Should we display their work?
progression: Extension of Lesson 9 - advanced craft skills
realWorldConnection: Creating home decorations for celebrations

title: Jeux de célébration multiculturels
oneGoal: Students learn and teach celebration games from different cultures
decisionPoints: Which cultural games interest students most?
Do they want to teach their families?
Should we document the games?
progression: Extension of Lesson 10 - cultural game sharing
realWorldConnection: Learning about games from different communities

title: Fête d'hiver communautaire
oneGoal: Students host their own winter celebration sharing all their learning
decisionPoints: How do students want to organize their celebration?
Who should they invite?
What elements are most important to include?
progression: Extension of Lesson 14 - student-led celebration
realWorldConnection: Organizing celebrations in their own communities
